Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL identifier, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, compound_records on record_id, docs on doc_id, and compound_structures on molregno. Filter for target CHEMBL4282 and standard_type IC50 with standard_units nM. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
